title: The Cold War in Latin America: review
goal: I can review the blocs, the Rio Treaty and the OAS, the guerrillas, foreign interventions and the divided continent.
grammar: review: relative clauses, se, the gerund, reported sources, imperfect and present perfect

items: I can review how the world split into two blocs after 1945.
I can review what the Rio Treaty and the OAS were.
I can review the guerrillas and the National Security Doctrine.
I can review the interventions in Guatemala, the Dominican Republic and Chile.
I can say how the world split into two blocs and what containment was.
I can say what was signed and founded in 1947 and 1948 using *se*.
I can describe two actions at the same time with the gerund.
I can report what governments and documents said about intervention.
I can contrast how things were with what has changed.
